name: gcplaying-registration-autotests
description: Автотесты регистрации для https://gcplaying0175.com/ на Playwright + TypeScript с отчётами Allure

scripts.report:generate: node scripts/promote-broken-steps.js && allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report
scripts.report: npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
scripts.test:wildies:full: npm run test:wildies:clean && npm run test:wildies
scripts.report:wildies:generate: node scripts/promote-broken-steps.js allure-results-wildies && node scripts/wildies-no-broken.js allure-results-wildies && allure generate allure-results-wildies --clean -o allure-report-wildies
scripts.report:wildies: npm run report:wildies:generate && npm run report:wildies:open
scripts.test:ferraplay:full: npm run test:ferraplay:clean && npm run test:ferraplay
scripts.report:ferraplay:generate: node scripts/promote-broken-steps.js allure-results-ferraplay && node scripts/wildies-no-broken.js allure-results-ferraplay && allure generate allure-results-ferraplay --clean -o allure-report-ferraplay
scripts.report:ferraplay: npm run report:ferraplay:generate && npm run report:ferraplay:open
scripts.report:spinoloco:generate: node scripts/promote-broken-steps.js allure-results-spinoloco && allure generate allure-results-spinoloco --clean -o allure-report-spinoloco
scripts.report:spinoloco: npm run report:spinoloco:generate && npm run report:spinoloco:open
